map.烧制曲线按陶土类型分档：低温陶烧成 1000 至 1150 ℃、中温陶 1150: Firing curves are banded by clay type: low-fire clay fires at 1000 to 1150 °C, mid-fire clay at 1150 to 1250 °C, and high-fire clay and porcelain at 1250 to 1300 °C; ramp up slowly at 80 to 100 °C per hour below 600 °C to prevent cracking from water vapor, then 100 to 150 °C per hour; soak for 20 to 30 minutes to level the glaze surface; cool at 60 to 100 °C per hour to avoid thermal shock, and ramp slowly through the quartz phase transition at 573 °C.
map.升温需平稳，避免骤升骤降导致开裂: Ramp up smoothly and avoid sudden rises and drops that cause cracking
map.100-200°C 阶段需缓慢排气，排出物理水分: The 100-200°C stage needs slow venting to drive off physical water
map.573°C 石英转变点需特别注意，体积变化易致裂: Pay special attention at the 573°C quartz transition point, where the volume change easily causes cracks
map.氧化保温阶段确保有机物充分燃烧排出: The oxidation soak stage ensures organic matter burns out fully
map.降温同样关键，自然降温至200°C以下再开窑: Cooling matters too; cool naturally below 200°C before opening the kiln
map.釉烧温度通常比素烧温度低50-100°C: Glaze firing is usually 50-100°C lower in temperature than bisque firing

map.对照泥料最高耐受温度确定峰值温度，避免过烧变形或欠烧不致密。: Check the clay's maximum tolerance temperature to set the peak, avoiding warping from over-firing or a porous body from under-firing.
map.估算各阶段耗时与总烧成时间，安排窑炉排程。: Estimate the time each stage takes and the total firing time, so you can schedule the kiln.
map.峰值温度：釉烧 = 泥料最高温度 − 80℃，素烧 = 泥料最高温度。泥料最高温: Peak temperature: glaze firing = clay max temperature − 80°C, bisque firing = clay max temperature. Clay max temperatures (°C): porcelain 1350, stoneware (high-fire clay) 1280, low-fire clay 1100, earthenware 1050, raku 1000. Bisque stages: room temperature→150°C (50°C/h, about 3h to drive off physical water), 150→300°C (100°C/h), 300→600°C (120°C/h, organics oxidizing), 600→800°C (150°C/h, passing the 573°C quartz transition), 800→peak (150°C/h), soak, then cool naturally below 200°C before opening the kiln. Glaze firing ramps slightly faster: 60/120/150/200/150 °C/h with a 20-30 min soak at the end to level the glaze.
map.炻器泥素烧：峰值取 1280℃，800→1280 段耗时 = (1280−800: Stoneware bisque firing: the peak is 1280°C, and the 800→1280 stage takes (1280−800)/150 ≈ 3.2 h, which with the earlier stages of about 8.3 h plus soaking and cooling of 6-8 h gives roughly 18 h per firing. Glaze firing of the same clay peaks at 1280−80 = 1200°C, and the 800→1200 stage is about 2.7 h.
map.石英在 573℃ 发生晶型转变并伴随体积突变，升温过快易导致坯体开裂，因此 60: Quartz undergoes a crystal form transition at 573 °C with a sudden volume change, and ramping too fast cracks the greenware, so the 600→800°C stage should stay at a moderate rate and pass smoothly.
map.为什么要降到 200℃ 以下再开窑？: Why cool below 200°C before opening the kiln?
map.急冷会使釉面与坯体因收缩不均而惊裂（尤其含方石英的坯体），自然缓冷至 200℃: Rapid cooling shocks the glaze and body through uneven contraction and can crack them (especially bodies containing cristobalite), so cooling naturally below 200 °C before opening the kiln significantly reduces the risk of cracking.
